meta.description: Professional pressure washing in Raleigh, NC. Driveways, house washing, patios, sidewalks & more. Fully insured. Free quotes.

hero.intro: Are you tired of looking at stubborn mold, dark algae stains, and built-up grime ruining your home's curb appeal? Welcome to AAA Houston Pressure Washing, LLC, Raleigh's premier exterior cleaning specialists since 2010.

intro_body: From North Hills and Brier Creek to Five Points and Downtown Raleigh, our crew has cleaned thousands of homes and businesses across the city. We bring commercial-grade equipment, eco-friendly cleaning solutions, and over a decade of experience to every job — big or small.

services.body: Remove oil stains, tire marks, mold, and embedded grime from concrete and asphalt driveways.
Safe soft washing for vinyl, hardie plank, brick, stucco, and wood siding.
Restore concrete, pavers, and brick patios to their original clean appearance.
Eliminate algae, mold, and slip hazards from walkways and entryways.
Clean wood, vinyl, and metal fences to remove mold, mildew, and discoloration.
Low-pressure soft washing for delicate surfaces including roofs and painted wood.
Professional biocide treatments to kill mold and algae at the root.
Full-service commercial exterior cleaning for Raleigh businesses and property managers.
